meals.week: Until Simon is at Support 3 and Dante at Support 2
meals.note: Order Goat Roast, Pumpkin Soup and Coffee-Berry Paste: each is Perfect for its table. Goliath and Ursula also need Support 3.
Gaitz takes the freed seat (Coffee-Berry Paste).

weekly.text: Renown order: god audiences when a temple shows gold (about 50), quick quests, then Empire's Safety
detail: Audiences don't come every week: the quests carry the plan.
Quick quests that need no Renown: Blight-Louse 50, Huge Hairy Beasts 80, Rare Stone 80, Garum 100, Purloined 80.
Also any Ch 6 to 7 quest still open from the 9/1 list.

missables.text: Pick For the Empire's Safety: a Specialty License and 200 Renown now
missables.lose: the other Sealed Letter chain on this path
missables.recover: A later path: subquests you finish carry over as auto-completes

options.gives: Specialty License, 200 Renown; Flamma Smugglers (Ch 10) pays 2 Wootz Steel
30 Renown; Assassination (Ch 10), then A Lost Object (Ch 11): Haze Badge

detail: Accept it from Captain Daniel (Hightown or Temple Row: find him with Map > People).
Carriage to Aragonia Posthouse, walk southeast, then Search the storehouse for the letter.
Don't talk to the Suspicious Knight at the Port about the letter: his quest locks this one out.

missables.text: Visit the Lowtown alley at 18:00 (pulsing circle): an optional scene plus an Event Clash
missables.lose: the scene and its Event Clash

missables.text: Clear the [[place:Uncharted Isle]] dungeon: [[item:Anguishing Shield]] and Thick Foreign Tome
missables.lose: both items on this path (Archive T from the tome is Part III)
detail: Can't reach the isle during the hunt? Skip it: the loot is minor.

missables.text: Turn in Garum, Garum, Garum! before the hunt starts on 7/21: free time ends then

note.text: Take each new recruit's Specialty exam the day they reach Lv 20: Jester, Goliath, Simon, Olympia
detail: Most of them get there in Ch 9: their rows are in that chapter.
Dante and Catania join at Renown 8 (usually Ch 10), about Lv 25 and already in a Specialty class.

buy.text: Buy 8 Advanced Licenses in [[place:Megaira]]: Renown 8 and Lv 35 unlock the exams (Ch 10)
detail: Short on gold (Dante's 8,000G comes in Ch 10)? Buy 4 now and the rest in Dagsion from Ch 10.
Expect the first four at Lv 35 in Ch 10, the other four in Ch 11 to 12.

buy.text: Buy or fish 5 Garum before 7/21 for Garum, Garum, Garum!

recruits.action: Finish his three short quests the day Renown 6 lands: follow each marker and report back
recruits.when: Late Ch 7 at best, usually early Ch 8
detail: Recruited in Ch 10 or later he joins about Lv 25 as a Myrmidon with a [[item:Levin Sword]].
That skips Dietrich's Vandahl Levin Sword barter but costs him the Ch 8 and 9 maps: this plan takes him now.

recruits.action: Finish her three quests the day Renown 6 lands; bring Scarlet Drops if one asks
recruits.when: Late Ch 7 at best, usually early Ch 8
detail: Deploy her every map from now: Ovate needs Black Magic B.
Her [[item:Magic Staff]] comes from Vandahl Dagsion (Zamir ×1); the Corroios chest copy is Fabio's.

recruits.action: Hand over 3 Giant's Meat once Renown 6 lands: a Giant always spawns at Sand-Shadow Fort
recruits.when: Ch 8 or 9, before the Ch 11 battle
detail: Recruit him early: he's 8th on the Advanced list.
More meat: Giant-icon skirmishes south of Breston and west of Credna's Temple (via Chiron Posthouse).
Those run around Lv 35 and give about 2 meat each; Luxury Meat Crates can also drop it.

recruits.action: Call Tails on his coin flip at Support 3 and Renown 7
detail: Fight with gauntlets from day one: Warrior needs Gauntlet B.

recruits.action: Pay 3,000G at Support 3 and Renown 7: she supports Simon, Ursula and Olympia
detail: Filler, bench only.

prep.text: Dante: build Support 2 and save 8,000G now; she joins at Renown 8, usually Ch 10
Catania: hold every Flying Manual for her (joins at Renown 8, usually Ch 10)
detail: Manuals: Dione Fort (Ch 6), Cindered Road Cave (Ch 7), the sculptor quest.

prep.text: Gaitz: if you can find him in Bertrand's army, start his meals now (Support 3 by Ch 12)

route.note: Renown 6, [[place:Dione Fort]]: unlocks Guardian for every later path
detail: Nobody here takes Guardian: Esmeralda's heavy armor and thrown spears suit Dreadnought better than Mag 20 heals.

route.note: Renown 7 (usually late Ch 8), [[place:Stoppered Shrine]]; if it comes too late, early Ch 9

sub.note: The pick: 200 Renown is the biggest single push toward Renown 7 and 8
detail: Not on the board? Check Temple Row and Hightown each week until 9/19.
If it never appears, Ch 9's Paralogues cover the Renown. You need Renown 10 for Gaitz.

sub.note: Skip: take the Haze Badge chain on a later path
5 Garum of any kind to the Wealthy Man at the Inn: 8,000G, before 7/21
[[place:Moonwatch Pass]], for the Peddler at Vandahl
[[place:Bugs' Burrow]], for the Soldier at the Port
[[place:Secret Altar]]: the White-Magic Manual goes to Yang Jie or Dante

explore.text: Sand-Shadow Fort: a guaranteed Giant (Giant's Meat), [[item:Gundogya]] (axe), Large Bullion
detail: Also a [[item:Concoction]].

explore.text: [[place:Aditi's Cave]]: about 7 Sandworms (best Sandworm Meat farm), Large Bullion, Spirit Board
detail: Skip Archive L: Fabio learns Luna at Black Magic A.
You come back for Damien at Renown 8 (usually Ch 10).

explore.text: Dragonbone Tangle: [[item:Hunter's Ring]], [[item:Hexlock Shield]], Lucky Coin
detail: The Hunter's Ring (Wt 4) is too heavy for Dietrich: his fallback is the [[item:Archer's Ring]].
The spare Hexlock Shield is Goliath's swap for mage maps.

explore.text: Fight Giant-icon skirmishes (around Lv 35) for the rest of Goliath's meat

battle.title: The hunt, then vs. the Sea Tyrant

tips.text: Hunt 7/21 to 7/31: use Answerer's Cry at Pasha Currents, Wandering Whirlpool and Eif Channel
detail: Cetus then appears at the Sea of Screams.

tips.text: Use the Magic Traps at the marked spots to stun Cetus
After the battle, nod to Fabio for a Support boost

loot.text: [[item:Grasitha]] (spear): give it to Esmeralda and stock thrown spears for Throwing Arm+

exitExtra.text: Advanced Licenses bought: 8, or 4 now and 4 in Dagsion in Ch 10
